The '''''Gamble''''' was a converted [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vanden Willard/Legends|Vanden Willard]] traveled aboard the ''Gamble'' on a mission to negotiate the purchase of materials to be used in the construction of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].
